subject: Is there any way to disable hover text displaying in a tabPanel?

messages.author: 7911474e9cc30aec
messages.subject: Is there any way to disable hover text displaying in a tabPanel?
parts:
Say I create the following tab panel inside of a tabsetPanel and run the shiny app:

tabPanel("Perfomance", ... )

When I look at the shiny app that's running in my browser, I notice that anywhere I hover my mouse within this tabPanel the hover text "Performance" appears next to my mouse. Is it possible to disable this hover text feature?

Thanks in advance!
